title: Hannah Montana is the Worst singer

arguments.text:
how can kids like Hannah Montana  
  
She seriously thinks shes sooooooo cool.  
  
Why can't she write her own songs.  
  
What's up with her teeth????????  
  
I HATE HANNAH MONTANA AND MILEY CYRUS--- ALTHOUGH THEY ARE BOTH THE SAME PERSON!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

I like to welcome top_contributor to debate.org and I hope she will have a good time here.  
  
Now to business... the resolution before us is, "Hannah Montana is the Worst singer". This is very straightforward, and shouldn't require much defining. Basically, my opponent needs to prove that Hannah Montana is the worst singer of all the singers that ever existed.  
  
I believe my opponent has given herself a very hard task. In order to prove Hannah Montana as the worst singer, she has the burden of explaining how she is so popular. The TV show gets high ratings and the concert tickets always are sold out. It seems like if Hannah Montana is a poor singer, people wouldn't go to her concerts to watch her sing.  
  
That is my case against my opponent's stance. Her own case, presented in the first round, should be completely dismissed. First, she said that Hannah Montana "think she's sooooooo cool". What the singer think of herself does not reflect her actual singing talent. Then my opponent said Hannah Montana does not write her own songs. This may be true, but we are debating whether she is a good singer or not, not whether she's a good song writer or not, so this point should be disregarded too. Then my opponent mentioned about her teeth. Having big teeth may be a handicap for singing, but it doesn't seem like it is affecting Hannah Montana's singing skills. So this point should be disregarded too.  
  
So there you have it, in this round, my opponent has failed to present any relevant arguments to support her claim, while I have shown that Hannah Montana is a remarkable singer due to her popularity. I wish my opponent best of luck in the second round.

Well this is just my opinion on Hannah Montana. All of my class mates think she is a try hard. She obviously is famous but lots of people don't like her. Some people like her and some people don't. Thats how it is. But there are more people that don't like her music than people who love her music. I rest my case!

I believe in this debate, my opponent never came close in proving that "Hannah Montana is the worst singer". My opponent gave some supporting arguments, but I have shown that they are all irrelevant in the first round. In the final round, my opponent asserted that more people dislike her than like her, yet she never cited evidence. Because my opponent has not bring adequate evidence into this debate, I urge the voters to vote CON!  
.
